support.heading: Help the archive grow
support.message: 21st Memory is free for everyone — no paywalls, no accounts. The archive is independently built and maintained, and hosting, tools, and AI currently cost more than the project covers alone. If it’s been useful, you can help in more than one way: share a topic, invite someone into the community, or contribute toward operating costs. Each one helps keep the archive open and growing.
